comment: Installed default: the installer puts this file next to OmniAPI.exe as shell.config.json. The bundled Python is {exe_dir}\python (standalone CPython with the dependencies and omniapi_mcp in its own site-packages; built by desktop/scripts/package.ps1) and the built GUI is {exe_dir}\gui. -I keeps PYTHONPATH / PYTHONHOME and the current folder out of it. The service runs in the data home, never inside the install folder (it is replaced on update). OMNIAPI_DESKTOP_EXE ({exe}, this OmniAPI.exe) lets the settings page turn the logon entry on and off with the same registry value as the tray's check mark; leave it out and the page does not offer the switch. update_check: once a day, one anonymous GET of the public repo's latest release; set enabled to false to turn it off.
